title: Android Queries
sourceNote: Mallarna är anpassade för copy-SQL i Forensics Toolbox, inspirerade av vanliga ALEAPP-/DFIR-artefakter. Verifiera schema mot din dump — Android/OEM varierar kraftigt.
generalCaveats: Paths och tabellnamn skiljer sig mellan Android-versioner, OEM (Samsung/Xiaomi/…) och om du har full filsystemsextrakt vs ADB backup.
Tider: MediaStore date_added/date_modified är ofta Unix-sekunder; date_taken kan vara ms. Jämför med Time Converter.
UsageStats lagras ofta som XML under /data/system/usagestats/ — då räcker inte SQL. Mallarna täcker även SQLite-varianter där de finns.
Queries är hypotesstöd. Kör schema-probe först.

categories.label: MediaStore / filer
categories.notes: Primär källa för bild-/videofiler på delad lagring. Nyare Android kan använda files-tabellen i stället för images/video.

queries.title: Schema-probe (tabeller)
queries.sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;

queries.title: Schema-probe (kolumner files)
queries.caveats: Om tabellen saknas: prova images / video.

queries.title: Sök filnamn i files (tider + MIME)
queries.caveats: date_added/date_modified = Unix s; date_taken ofta ms — justera datetime() om värden ser fel ut.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  _id,
  _data,
  _display_name,
  mime_type,
  media_type,
  datetime(date_added, 'unixepoch') AS date_added_utc,
  datetime(date_modified, 'unixepoch') AS date_modified_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN date_taken > 1000000000000 THEN datetime(date_taken/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN date_taken > 0 THEN datetime(date_taken, 'unixepoch')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS date_taken_utc,
  date_added AS unix_added,
  date_modified AS unix_modified,
  date_taken AS raw_taken,
  width,
  height,
  owner_package_name
FROM files
WHERE IFNULL(_display_name, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(_data, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY date_added DESC;

queries.title: Senaste bild-/mediafiler (översikt)
queries.sql:
SELECT
  _id,
  _data,
  _display_name,
  mime_type,
  media_type,
  owner_package_name,
  datetime(date_added, 'unixepoch') AS date_added_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN date_taken > 1000000000000 THEN datetime(date_taken/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN date_taken > 0 THEN datetime(date_taken, 'unixepoch')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS date_taken_utc
FROM files
WHERE mime_type LIKE 'image/%'
   OR mime_type LIKE 'video/%'
   OR media_type IN (1, 3)
ORDER BY date_added DESC
LIMIT 200;

queries.title: Media runt tidpunkt (Unix s)
queries.caveats: Ange Unix-sekunder (UTC). Använd Time Converter. Jämför både date_added och date_taken.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  _id,
  _data,
  _display_name,
  mime_type,
  owner_package_name,
  datetime(date_added, 'unixepoch') AS date_added_utc,
  datetime(date_modified, 'unixepoch') AS date_modified_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN date_taken > 1000000000000 THEN datetime(date_taken/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN date_taken > 0 THEN datetime(date_taken, 'unixepoch')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS date_taken_utc,
  date_added,
  date_taken
FROM files
WHERE (date_added BETWEEN {{unixStart}} AND {{unixEnd}})
   OR (
        CASE
          WHEN date_taken > 1000000000000 THEN date_taken/1000
          ELSE date_taken
        END
      ) BETWEEN {{unixStart}} AND {{unixEnd}}
ORDER BY date_added DESC;

queries.title: ALEAPP-tips (usagestats XML)
queries.caveats: Detta är en checklista i SQL-kommentarform — körs inte mot DB.
queries.sql:
-- Android App Usage (UsageStats)
-- Typisk path: /data/system/usagestats/<user_id>/
-- Innehåll: daily/weekly/monthly/yearly XML (eller analog struktur per Android-version)
--
-- Rekommenderat flöde:
-- 1) Extrahera usagestats-mappen från filsystemsimage
-- 2) Kör ALEAPP med relevant usage-artefakt aktiverad
-- 3) Läs rapport: last time used / time in foreground / activity
-- 4) Korsreferera med MediaStore date_taken/date_added för bildfilen
--
-- ALEAPP: https://github.com/abrignoni/ALEAPP
-- Sök i ALEAPP artifacts efter: usagestats, appusage, offlineUsage, etc.

categories.label: Kameraaktivitet
categories.apiHint: Beroende på OEM; MediaStore + app-privata DB:er
dbPathHints: OEM gallery DB:er (cmh.db m.fl. — se ALEAPP)
categories.notes: Det finns sällan en enda 'camera.db' för alla Android. Kombinera MediaStore (DCIM/Camera) med OEM-/Google Camera-artefakter via ALEAPP.

queries.title: MediaStore: filer under DCIM/Camera
queries.caveats: Stark indikator på kamerafångst, men screenshot/other apps kan också spara under DCIM.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  _id,
  _data,
  _display_name,
  mime_type,
  owner_package_name,
  datetime(date_added, 'unixepoch') AS date_added_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN date_taken > 1000000000000 THEN datetime(date_taken/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN date_taken > 0 THEN datetime(date_taken, 'unixepoch')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS date_taken_utc
FROM files
WHERE IFNULL(_data, '') LIKE '%/DCIM/Camera/%'
   OR IFNULL(_data, '') LIKE '%/DCIM/CAMERA/%'
ORDER BY date_added DESC
LIMIT 300;

queries.title: DCIM/Camera runt tidpunkt (Unix s)
queries.caveats: Bra steg i playbook: 'var kameran aktiv?' via media nära T.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  _id,
  _data,
  _display_name,
  mime_type,
  owner_package_name,
  datetime(date_added, 'unixepoch') AS date_added_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN date_taken > 1000000000000 THEN datetime(date_taken/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN date_taken > 0 THEN datetime(date_taken, 'unixepoch')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS date_taken_utc,
  date_added,
  date_taken
FROM files
WHERE (IFNULL(_data, '') LIKE '%/DCIM/Camera/%' OR IFNULL(_data, '') LIKE '%/DCIM/CAMERA/%')
  AND (
    (date_added BETWEEN {{unixStart}} AND {{unixEnd}})
    OR (
      CASE WHEN date_taken > 1000000000000 THEN date_taken/1000 ELSE date_taken END
    ) BETWEEN {{unixStart}} AND {{unixEnd}}
  )
ORDER BY date_added DESC;

queries.title: Media ägd av kamera-app
queries.caveats: owner_package_name måste finnas. Utöka LIKE-listan för OEM-kameror.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  _id,
  _data,
  _display_name,
  owner_package_name,
  mime_type,
  datetime(date_added, 'unixepoch') AS date_added_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN date_taken > 1000000000000 THEN datetime(date_taken/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN date_taken > 0 THEN datetime(date_taken, 'unixepoch')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS date_taken_utc
FROM files
WHERE IFNULL(owner_package_name, '') LIKE '%camera%'
   OR IFNULL(owner_package_name, '') LIKE '%Camera%'
   OR IFNULL(owner_package_name, '') IN (
        'com.google.android.GoogleCamera',
        'com.sec.android.app.camera',
        'com.android.camera',
        'com.huawei.camera',
        'com.miui.camera'
      )
ORDER BY date_added DESC
LIMIT 300;
